method: Three actual native image_gen atlases, using inspected local references. Sharp performs alpha segmentation, shared scale and baseline normalization only; no new or duplicated poses are painted or generated by code.

sources.prompt:
Create ONE native purpose-drawn pixel-art CHARACTER ANIMATION ATLAS with actual transparent alpha (RGBA), portrait aspect about 1024 x 2048, FOUR columns by EIGHT rows = EXACTLY 32 full-body drawings, one character in each cell. Use the attached local image only for costume/identity/art style, not its old four-row poses or layout. Draw eight NEW action sequences. Original Final Fantasy XIII (2009/2010) version only: NO Final Fantasy XIII-2, NO Lightning Returns, no costume swap, no Eidolon form, no vehicle, no summoned creature. Crisp detailed discrete pixels, same readable proportions as reference. Each of the four poses within each row must change actual limbs/body posture visibly; all 32 figures distinct, no duplicated tiles, flips, glow-only variants, recycled old poses or procedural tween look. FOUR equal columns, EIGHT separated rows, large transparent gutters: leave generous 12% safe padding on EVERY side of EACH cell. No head, gun, boomerang, raised fist, boot, coat, spark, aura or arc may touch the frame edge or overlap another cell. Center full figures with a shared baseline within each row. Mostly screen-right 3/4 view. No labels, grid, text, title, panels, borders, watermark, checkerboard or opaque background/ground rectangle.
EXACT row order: row1 intro, row2 outro, row3 roundVictory, row4 roundDefeat, row5 fatality (a non-gory adapted finale of the SAME named technique as the super; no opponent or execution), row6 victory, row7 defeat, row8 super. Row3 small round success and row6 complete match celebration must differ. Row4 recoverable round setback and row7 lasting defeat must differ. Row5 and row8 are BOTH based on the named full-ATB technique, but draw genuinely different new poses for each, never alias the two rows. Capture each specific action clearly, not generic fantasy blasts. No enemy, blood, gore, sexualization or death body.

SNOW VILLIERS, original Final Fantasy XIII: tall broad adult man, pale blond shoulder-length hair under BLACK KNIT BEANIE, long open TAN coat with rolled sleeves and dark shoulder patches, dark inner shirt, black loose trousers, black fingerless gloves, heavy brown-black laced boots, blue plaid cloth hanging at waist. Same youthful-adult original face as reference. He fights with his FISTS and coat-enhanced physical strength; NO firearm whatsoever despite a legacy data label, no sword, ice axe or giant boxing gauntlet. Keep both hands anatomically readable.
ROW1 INTRO four distinct frames: (1) long confident walking step with coat trailing and fists low; (2) stops and adjusts black beanie with right hand; (3) presses one fist into opposite palm at chest while turning shoulder; (4) plants a wide boxer/Sentinel stance, front fist raised and rear fist at chin.
ROW2 OUTRO: (1) relaxes fists and straightens coat; (2) turns torso halfway away with left boot pivoting; (3) gives broad friendly over-shoulder wave; (4) strides left in back-three-quarter departure with scarf/coat moving.
ROW3 ROUND VICTORY: (1) pulls fist back from a finishing guard; (2) small chest-level fist pump with confident smile; (3) taps right fist to chest, weight on back foot; (4) grins in relaxed one-hand-on-hip pose, other glove lowered.
ROW4 ROUND DEFEAT: (1) recoils with forearms crossed; (2) drops to one knee, left palm braced on ground; (3) pushes up off thigh with head lowered; (4) returns to a tired low two-fist guard, standing ready again.
ROW5 FINALE SOVEREIGN FIST: (1) crouches deeply and coils his RIGHT fist beside ribs, head turned strongly right; (2) leaps forward with left knee high and right leg extended backward, RIGHT fist drawn overhead and coat spread, BOTH feet visibly airborne; (3) dives down-right, RIGHT gloved fist near the floor in a powerful downward punch, left arm stretched behind for balance, one short white ground-shock crescent and small dust flecks below; (4) lands in a wide one-knee stance, fist just withdrawn to waist and face looking up, dust subsiding. No target is drawn. This must be an airborne descending punch, NOT a standing jab row.
ROW6 MATCH VICTORY: (1) throws both arms open with relieved grin; (2) raises one fist fully above beanie height while leaning back; (3) laughs with both fists up, one foot lifted in triumphant hop; (4) settles with arms crossed proudly over chest, broad smile.
ROW7 MATCH DEFEAT: (1) shoulders slump and one hand holds side; (2) sinks onto both knees, coat pooling; (3) folds forward and braces both hands on ground; (4) sits exhausted on one hip with head bowed, knee bent and glove over thigh, fully non-graphic.
ROW8 SUPER SOVEREIGN FIST, FOUR NEW POSES DIFFERENT FROM ROW5: (1) runs forward low with right fist cocked behind hip and left arm up, opposite boot striding far ahead; (2) jumps almost vertically into a compact curled pose with BOTH knees tucked, RIGHT fist raised above head, left forearm across chest and coat hanging below, clearly airborne; (3) drops almost vertically onto a different deep crouch with RIGHT fist driven straight down, hips low, left palm open beside face, a compact circular pale impact ripple and little stone/dust fragments around the feet; (4) rises out of the crouch with right elbow pulled far back and left fist guarding, coat settling. Preserve bare-fist identity and dramatic lift-to-impact silhouette, no magical projectile, weapon, wings, huge explosion or Shiva motorcycle.
sources.sourceReference: Snow’s original Commando full-ATB skill Sovereign Fist: forward approach, upward leap and one descending physical fist impact with a ground shock; no gun or Shiva transformation.

SAZH KATZROY, original Final Fantasy XIII: adult Black man with medium afro, moustache and short goatee, olive GREEN long military-style coat, pale striped shirt open at collar, brown belted trousers, dark gloves and black boots. Use the reference's exact age, skin tone, hair and clothing. Small yellow chocobo chick may peek from hair/collar as an incidental companion, never attack or transform. His weapons are TWO compact dark/silver semi-automatic PISTOLS, one per hand. Include both actual pistols whenever firing. No long rifle in place of the pair, no sword, staff, futuristic cannon, transformed car or Eidolon.
ROW1 INTRO: (1) steps in with both pistols angled safely down; (2) tilts head and scratches side of afro with one hand, the other gun low; (3) draws both pistols forward to chest-ready; (4) assumes a cautious two-gun stance with elbows bent and one boot ahead.
ROW2 OUTRO: (1) lowers both muzzles and releases shoulders; (2) slides left pistol toward hip holster and turns torso left; (3) gives a short weary departing nod, right gun safely down; (4) walks left in three-quarter rear view with coat hem swaying.
ROW3 ROUND VICTORY: (1) exhales with guns low after action; (2) makes a small relieved shoulder shrug, one elbow raised; (3) smiles and touches forehead with back of wrist, other gun resting low; (4) casually settles his weight on one boot and gives a restrained nod.
ROW4 ROUND DEFEAT: (1) recoils with both pistols held inward and away from face; (2) ducks into a deep one-knee cover stance; (3) pushes up using one hand on thigh, pistol kept safely low; (4) returns to cautious crouched dual-pistol ready, tired expression.
ROW5 FINALE COLD BLOOD: (1) spreads feet wide and draws both elbows back, each hand holding a pistol; (2) twists torso right and extends RIGHT pistol toward empty right, left pistol bent up by shoulder, short muzzle flash on right; (3) reverses shoulder rotation and thrusts LEFT pistol rightward while RIGHT gun recoils upward, a different compact flash and few shells; (4) steps back with crossed forearms at chest and BOTH muzzles safely lowered, final faint smoke. This is a dense alternating gun volley condensed into four poses, no victim or magical blast.
ROW6 MATCH VICTORY, BASED ON ORIGINAL GUN-SPIN/HOLSTER/HAND-DUSTING GESTURE: (1) spins BOTH pistols visibly with fingers inside trigger guards, arms extended apart; (2) brings both pistols toward their hip holsters, elbows flared and torso leaning forward slightly; (3) with pistols now holstered, briskly dusts/claps palms together in front of chest; (4) relaxes with hands open at sides and a tired satisfied smile.
ROW7 MATCH DEFEAT: (1) stoops holding side, both guns safely down; (2) drops to one knee and lays pistols beside boot; (3) sits back onto floor with one palm braced behind and head low; (4) rests seated with knees bent, elbow on knee and tired head in hand, guns safely on floor.
ROW8 SUPER COLD BLOOD, FOUR ENTIRELY NEW POSES DIFFERENT FROM ROW5: (1) crouches low on bent rear knee and brings TWO pistols to equal shoulder height aimed right; (2) fires both guns in a staggered rhythm from a forward lunge, left arm extended lower and right arm higher, two small unequal ballistic muzzle flashes; (3) shifts to the opposite foot with torso leaning back through recoil, RIGHT pistol extended level-right and LEFT pistol extended diagonally up-right, alternating flashes and shells implying a sustained volley; (4) swings both elbows down into a low wide stance with both weapons still visible, smoke wisp from each muzzle. No beam, energy orb, flamethrower, gun transformation, explosion or vehicle. Original Cold Blood is a physical gunfire sequence, not cold magic; never draw ice crystals merely because of its name.
sources.sourceReference: Sazh’s original Ravager full-ATB skill Cold Blood: a long alternating dual-pistol gunfire volley building the target’s chain, adapted to four poses; no Eidolon or vehicle substitution.

HOPE ESTHEIM from ORIGINAL Final Fantasy XIII, the same adolescent boy as reference, NOT adult Academy Hope from XIII-2 and NOT Lightning Returns version. Small youthful build, silver tousled hair, green eyes, mustard ORANGE/YELLOW cropped short-sleeve jacket over black and pale vest panels, teal neck scarf trailing behind, olive cropped trousers with belts/pouches, dark fingerless gloves, brown/gray boots. Age-appropriate ordinary original clothing, no adult growth or costume redesign. His physical weapon is a compact SILVER/BLUE Airwing BOOMERANG, a curved futuristic wing-shaped throwing weapon, not a sword, staff, giant V blade, shield, gun or scythe. When casting, Airwing may be held lowered or at belt. Last Resort is NON-ELEMENTAL OFFENSIVE MAGIC: small luminous magical blasts launch upward and later rain downward, not an Eidolon summon and not healing.
ROW1 INTRO: (1) takes a cautious forward step holding compact Airwing low at side; (2) looks up and adjusts teal scarf with free hand; (3) raises boomerang across chest with free palm guarding; (4) settles into a light bent-knee battle-ready pose.
ROW2 OUTRO: (1) lowers Airwing and relaxes shoulders; (2) turns torso left while scarf swings; (3) glances back over shoulder and gives a small open-hand wave; (4) walks left in back-three-quarter view, boomerang lowered safely.
ROW3 ROUND VICTORY: (1) draws free fist to chest and exhales; (2) small relieved fist pump at shoulder, Airwing in other hand low; (3) smiles shyly and nods with knees slightly bent; (4) rests one hand at scarf with boomerang beside hip, quiet confidence.
ROW4 ROUND DEFEAT: (1) flinches with forearms up; (2) drops to one knee with free fingertips on ground; (3) pushes up while holding Airwing close to chest; (4) regains a tired low defensive stance, eyes forward.
ROW5 FINALE LAST RESORT: (1) stands with one foot far back, Airwing lowered in LEFT hand and RIGHT open palm drawing a small white-gold light above shoulder; (2) leans slightly back and raises RIGHT palm high, a few separate luminous spheres rising upward in a narrow curved trail well inside the cell; (3) pivots torso right with BOTH arms open and the compact boomerang visible in left, several small white/blue magical motes visibly descending diagonally down-right from above, no opponent; (4) lowers right hand to chest and exhales with Airwing at waist while the last descending sparks fade. This is an offensive magical barrage, not a blessing or a white magic heal.
ROW6 MATCH VICTORY: (1) raises boomerang high above head with a relieved smile; (2) turns sideways and gives one delighted short hop with free arm raised; (3) lowers weapon and places free hand over heart with grateful smile; (4) stands straight and gives a broad friendly two-finger salute, Airwing at hip.
ROW7 MATCH DEFEAT: (1) slumps, head low and weapon hand lowered; (2) sinks onto both knees with scarf draped; (3) sits sideways with bent knees, free hand braced on floor; (4) curls slightly forward seated with forearms on knees, boomerang safely beside him, exhausted but not injured.
ROW8 SUPER LAST RESORT, FOUR NEW POSES DIFFERENT FROM ROW5: (1) crouches with compact Airwing held close across torso in LEFT hand, RIGHT palm cupped at waist as faint white-gold light gathers; (2) rises strongly onto toes and extends BOTH hands upward at different heights, boomerang still readable, a fan of separate small white/blue luminous blasts arcs toward the sky, all effects contained inside cell; (3) spreads stance and bends torso forward with RIGHT palm thrust down-right, several distinct luminous spheres raining downward from high right around him in a curved pattern, scarf lifted by motion; (4) draws RIGHT hand back to shoulder and lowers Airwing in LEFT hand while shifting into a wide recovering guard, a last few downward motes disappearing. Keep actual casting posture different in all four frames. No giant beam, angel wings, holy cross, floating adult body, Alexander robot/castle/Eidolon, summoned creature, weapon morph or new costume. Do not turn Last Resort into a simple physical boomerang throw or benign heal.
